verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents screening customers, defined as persons or companies, against a global database of sanctions and watchlists. Screening configurations let users select the appropriate screening lists, and multiple configurations can be created and chosen per customer, with both synchronous and asynchronous screening modes. Missing for 10: granular documentation of which individual lists can be selected, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the screening behavior.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: you can check your customers against a global database of Sanctions, Warning, Fitness and Probity and Watchlists
A customer is a person or company that has a direct relationship with your company.
Screening configurations should be set up in collaboration with a compliance or risk team to ensure the appropriate screening lists are selected.
You can create multiple configurations and select the appropriate one for each customer during the screening process.
